description: The UIC Pass-2 sign gate is not the operator-selection LP's active set. The gate's comment derives it from complementary slackness on prop:operator-selection-lp; solved on the same ten Wedderburn blocks, the LP's active set is essentially every block at every reachable target while the gate keeps 4 of 10 (A=2) and 2 of 10 (A=4). Structural reason: orthogonal Wedderburn projectors make the Frobenius Gram diagonal, so complementary slackness decouples to s_l*G_ll*x_l=0 and never mentions the atom traces the gate reads. Proved sorry-free in QOU.MassTheory.UICGateNotFromComplementarySlackness.

2H.cost_is_not_a_gram_row_note: A diagonal Gram has row lambda = (0,...,t_lambda,...,0), which is not the cost vector t unless d = 1. So the NF-basis degeneracy (t = G row 0, forcing optimal value 0 and y0* = 0) does NOT carry over to the Wedderburn-block instance -- measured y0* != 0 here.
2H.gram_diagonal_reason: Wedderburn block projectors are orthogonal idempotents: G_lm = tr_M(P_l P_m) = delta_lm tr_M(P_l).
